类 ValidatingPrompt

java.lang.Object
org.bukkit.conversations.ValidatingPrompt
所有已实现的接口:

直接已知子类:
BooleanPrompt, FixedSetPrompt, NumericPrompt, PlayerNamePrompt, RegexPrompt
@Deprecated(forRemoval=true) public abstract class ValidatingPrompt extends java.lang.Object implements Prompt
已过时, 待删除: 此 API 元素将从以后的版本中删除。
The conversation API has been deprecated for removal. This system does not support component based messages and has been slowly losing functionality over the years as Minecraft has changed that this API can not adapt to. It is recommended you instead manually listen to the AsyncChatEvent or alternatively using Dialog to get user input.
ValidatingPrompt 是任何需要验证的提示的基类。ValidatingPrompt 将不断重放提示文本，直到用户输入有效的响应。

原文： ValidatingPrompt is the base class for any prompt that requires validation. ValidatingPrompt will keep replaying the prompt text until the user enters a valid response.

    • acceptInput

      @Nullable public @Nullable Prompt acceptInput(@NotNull @NotNull ConversationContext context, @Nullable @Nullable java.lang.String input)
      已过时, 待删除: 此 API 元素将从以后的版本中删除。
      接受并处理来自用户的输入并进行验证。如果验证失败，返回此提示以重新执行，否则返回提示图中的下一个 Prompt。

      原文： Accepts and processes input from the user and validates it. If validation fails, this prompt is returned for re-execution, otherwise the next Prompt in the prompt graph is returned.

      指定者:
      acceptInput 在接口中 Prompt
      参数:
      context - 关于对话的上下文信息。

      原文：Context information about the conversation.

      input - 来自用户的输入文本。

      原文：The input text from the user.

      返回:
      此提示或提示图中的下一个 Prompt。

      原文：This prompt or the next Prompt in the prompt graph.
